proxy_reward_note: Agents are NOT trained on the satisfaction term. TRPO is on-policy: every rollout uses the proxy reward to compute advantages.

trpo_specific_notes.kl_constraint: Policy update constrained to KL(old||new) <= target_kl (sb3-contrib param name, via conjugate gradient)
trpo_specific_notes.conjugate_gradient: cg_max_steps iterations of CG to solve the natural gradient direction
trpo_specific_notes.n_critic_updates: Value function updated N times per rollout (separate from policy update)
trpo_specific_notes.sub_sampling_factor: Fraction of rollout buffer sampled for each update iteration
trpo_specific_notes.no_clip_range: TRPO uses target_kl (KL constraint), not clip_range (that is PPO-specific)
trpo_specific_notes.line_search: TRPO uses backtracking line search to ensure KL constraint is satisfied
trpo_specific_notes.predecessor_of_ppo: PPO approximates TRPO constraint with a simpler clip objective
trpo_specific_notes.first_evaluation: TRPO had no results in the original EV2Gym paper. This is the first evaluation on this benchmark.

vecnorm_freeze: VecNormalize stats frozen after training (training=False, norm_reward=False) before ALL evaluation episodes.
optuna_asymmetry_note: F2 searches same 30 trials as F1 but across 3 additional YAML dims.
mpc_horizon_note: EV2Gym paper MPC uses horizon=25 steps (Table VII). Our reproduced variant could not match that config — treated as a distinct controller.
paper_ref_note: TRPO evaluated in EV2Gym Table VII WITHOUT HPO (default SB3). Our framework adds two-phase Optuna HPO — improvement over these values shows the contribution of systematic tuning.
single_scenario_note: All results are from the workplace scenario only.
statistical_note: High std relative to mean expected in Phase 2. Treat rankings as directional only without bootstrap CIs.
